stemMd: Some editors are translators. Every translator speaks at least two languages. What must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every bilingual person is an editor.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some editors speak at least two languages.

explanationMd: The editors who are translators inherit the property of speaking at least two languages. No statement about all editors or translators outside the overlap follows.

distractorRationale.c: At least two permits three or more.
distractorRationale.a: The premises give no reverse implication.
distractorRationale.d: The overlap does not establish translators outside it.
